reader_summary.headline: I've become very interested in the best software tools in investing.
reader_summary.overview: I've become very interested in the best software tools in investing. And when I asked Twitter for the best Bloomberg alternative, the overwhelming winner was an excellent new product called Coiffin. It's a web-based platform that lets you analyze stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, and other asset classes in one place.

key_points.text: I've been using it every day to track what's going on in the market, and I think if you try it, you will too.

thesis: Peter Zeihan argues that in a post-Cold War world where the U.S. is disengaging, countries must possess territorial viability, food self-sufficiency, sustainable demographics, and energy access to survive. He concludes that only about five nations currently meet all four criteria, with the United States and Japan ranking in the top tier despite Japan's demographic and energy challenges.
